import requests
auth_resp = requests.post('https://api.example.com/auth/token', data={...})
token = auth_resp.json()['access_token']``` | | 2 | **Build the request URL** – the endpoint usually looks like `/domains/{domain}/comments`. | `https://api.example.com/domains/apple.com/comments` | `url = f"https://api.example.com/domains/apple.com/comments"` | | 3 | **Add the `delta_key`** – either as a query parameter or a custom header. Most APIs use `?delta_key=`. | `?delta_key=YOUR_DELTA_KEY` | `params = {'delta_key': 'YOUR_DELTA_KEY'}` | | 4 | **Send the request** – include the bearer token in the `Authorization` header. | ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
"https://api.example.com/domains/apple.com/comments?delta_key=YOUR_DELTA_KEY"``` | ```python
headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'}
resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)``` | | 5 | **Handle the response** – the API will return a JSON payload with the comments that have changed since the last `delta_key`. | ```json
{ "comments": [ { "id": 123, "text": "Great product!", ... }, ... ], "next_delta_key": "NEW_KEY" }``` | ```python
data = resp.json()
comments = data['comments']
next_delta_key = data.get('next_delta_key')``` | ### Full cURL example ```bash # 1. Get an access token TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.example.com/auth/token \ -d "client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID&client_secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET" \ -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" | jq -r .access_token) # 2. Pull comments for apple.com using your delta_key curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ "https://api.example.com/domains/apple.com/comments?delta_key=YOUR_DELTA_KEY" | jq . ``` ### Full Python example ```python import requests # 1. Authenticate auth_resp = requests.post( "https://api.example.com/auth/token", data={ "client_id": "YOUR_CLIENT_ID", "client_secret": "YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET", }, ) auth_resp.raise_for_status() token = auth_resp.json()["access_token"] # 2. Work with the data comments = data["comments"] next_delta_key = data.get("next_delta_key") print(f"Fetched {len(comments)} comments.") print(f"Next delta key: {next_delta_key}") ``` ### Things to keep in mind 1. **Rate limits** – many APIs throttle requests. If you hit a limit, wait or back‑off before retrying. 2. **Pagination** – if the API paginates results, look for a `next_page` or similar field and loop until all pages are retrieved. 3. **Error handling** – always check `resp.status_code` and handle 4xx/5xx responses gracefully. 4. **Storing the new `delta_key`** – after each successful fetch, persist the `next_delta_key` so you can use it for the next incremental pull. 5. **Permissions** – ensure your API key or OAuth token has the scope to read comments for the domain.
